answers.reason: As a member of the central university leadership, the vice president for studies takes part in the senate, which is the central body for university-wide matters.
Budget allocation is the specific domain of the chancellor, and members do not sit in bodies that deal with other kinds of questions.
The vice president for studies is responsible for teaching and degree programmes, which are strictly separated from professorial appointments.
The faculty council decides the affairs of a single faculty, and central leadership members do not sit in bodies outside their specific university-wide place.

Because the vice president for studies is directly responsible for degree programmes and quality of teaching, they are permitted to take part in the body that prepares changes to degree programmes and advises on teaching.
Although responsible for university-wide examination frameworks, the examination board handles individual student cases at the faculty level rather than central university matters.
Research funding is completely separate from the vice president's remit of studies and teaching.
Rewriting specific module descriptions for a single programme is a local working task outside the central leadership's one designated place.
Decisions about laboratory equipment have no bearing on study programmes and fall outside the vice president's area of responsibility.
Planning the orientation week for new students is a local student-related activity outside the formal remit of the vice president for studies.
